name: prompt-mentions
title: Mentions and commands
description: Reference people and records with @ and run actions with / from the prompt bar.

PromptMentionsMenu.description: The mentions and commands menu by itself, with its status region, for a field that isn't a textarea (a contenteditable editor): drive it with `usePromptMenuState`, spread its `menuProps`, and add `onPick` and an anchor. Focus never moves into it: the field keeps focus and points at the list with `aria-controls` and `aria-activedescendant`.

props.name: kind
props.description: Names the menu: Mentions or Commands.

props.name: items
props.description: The rows; null while the first answer to a mention search is coming.

props.name: viaKeys
props.description: The highlight was moved with the keys (it draws the keyboard look).

props.name: query
props.description: The trigger and the text after it ("@ta"), for "No results for “@ta”".

props.name: listId
props.description: The listbox's id; option `i` is `${listId}-${i}`, for the field's `aria-activedescendant`.

props.name: message
props.description: What the status region says: the number of suggestions, a token added or removed.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Radix asked to close (Escape): keep it shut until the trigger changes.

props.name: anchorRef
props.description: The element the menu opens next to.

props.name: virtualAnchor
props.description: A rect to open next to instead, such as the caret's or the trigger character's in a contenteditable. Pass a new object when it moves; it wins over `anchorRef`.

props.name: matchAnchorWidth
props.description: The menu is as wide as the anchor (PromptBar's). False gives it a fixed 288px.

Mention.description: A mention in text that isn't a field: a sent message, a rich text editor's content. It reads as what it says ("@Tara Mendes") and wears a mention token's look: status/brand-bg with a status/brand-border edge, radius-sm, 3px past the text on each side, in medium text/default. The look is plain CSS on `[data-slot="mention"]` (styles/components/mention.css), so an editor that builds the same `<span data-slot="mention">` without React gets it too. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `span`.

props.name: label
props.description: The name after the trigger: "Tara Mendes".

props.name: id
props.description: Your id for the person or record, as `data-mention-id` (not the element's `id`).
